faqs.a: A good pair contrasts without clashing: typically a distinctive display font for headings and a highly readable text font for body. Serif + sans-serif is the classic safe combination, which is why most pairs here follow it.
faqs.q: What makes a good font pairing?

faqs.a: Filter by style: modern (Poppins + Roboto), classic (Merriweather + Open Sans), friendly (Montserrat + Lato), bold (Oswald + Source Sans 3) or editorial (Playfair Display + Inter).
